mapper.select: SELECT DATE(DATE_ADD(started_at, INTERVAL 9 HOUR)) AS day, SUM(counted_seconds) AS total FROM score_views WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND started_at >= #{from} AND started_at < #{to} GROUP BY day

SELECT DATE(DATE_ADD(ps.started_at, INTERVAL 9 HOUR)) AS day, COUNT(*) AS done_count, COUNT(e.id) AS scored_count, COALESCE(SUM(e.total_score), 0) AS score_sum FROM practice_sessions ps LEFT JOIN evaluations e ON e.session_id = ps.id WHERE ps.user_id = #{userId} AND ps.status = 'DONE' AND ps.started_at >= #{from} AND ps.started_at < #{to} GROUP BY day
